chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said: A man from the people of Egypt narrated to me from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
He said: Raisins strengthen the nerves, remove exhaustion, and improve the breath.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of raisins according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* through a chain of prominent Kufan and Egyptian narrators, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) underscores the Prophetic tradition of *al-Tibb al-Nabawi* by identifying raisins as a potent remedy for strengthening the nerves (*al-asab*), alleviating physical fatigue (*al-nasab*), and purifying the breath. This narration reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the integration of spiritual and physical well-being, viewing dietary practices as a means to maintain the body as a trust from God.
